title: Edge saved passwords
whyItMatters: Holds every username and password saved in Edge. The values are encrypted with the Windows account, but scripts that can run as that user can decrypt them.
source: Chromium user data directory docs, profile files include Login Data (Edge uses this layout): https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/docs/user_data_dir.md
notes: One Login Data file per profile. Work profiles may also sync these passwords to a Microsoft 365 account.

cleanup.exportFirst: In Edge, press Alt+F and choose Passwords, then Export passwords to a file you keep. The file is not protected, so keep it safe.
cleanup.signOut: In Edge, open Settings > Profiles and sign out, so the profile stops syncing saved passwords to the Microsoft account.
steps: In Edge, delete the saved passwords you no longer need from Passwords and autofill.
Delete the login data file named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Without the export, every password saved in Edge is lost; while the profile stays signed in, sync can restore the file.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Export passwords in Microsoft Edge: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/edge/export-passwords-in-microsoft-edge
